'''Steven M. Awodey'''<ref name=":0">[https://philpapers.org/rec/AWOLIT Steven M. Awodey, ''Logic in Topoi'' – PhilPapers]</ref> ({{IPAc-en|ˈ|aʊ|d|i}}; born 1959) is an American [[mathematician]] and [[logician]]. He is a Professor of [[Philosophy]] and [[Mathematics]] at [[Carnegie Mellon University]].

==Biography==
Awodey studied [[mathematics]] and [[philosophy]] at the [[University of Marburg]] and the [[University of Chicago]]. He earned his Ph.D. from Chicago under [[Saunders Mac Lane]] in 1997. He is an active researcher in the areas of [[category theory]] and [[logic]], and has also written on the [[philosophy of mathematics]]. He is one of the originators of the field of [[homotopy type theory]].<ref>[https://www.loria.fr/~lamarche/listPart.html Preliminary list of PSSL86 participants]</ref> He was a member of the School of Mathematics at the [[Institute for Advanced Study]] in 2012–13.<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.ias.edu/people/cos/users/awodey |title=Institute for Advanced Study: A Community of Scholars |access-date=2015-01-10 |archive-date=2015-11-25 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20151125095126/https://www.ias.edu/people/cos/users/awodey }}</ref>

== Personal life ==
Awodey is the brother of late artist [[Marc Awodey]].<ref name="v578">{{cite web | last=Soychak | first=Paul | title=The Burlington Free Press | website=Legacy.com | date=2012-10-18 | url=https://www.legacy.com/us/obituaries/burlingtonfreepress/name/marc-awodey-obituary?id=25035429 }}</ref><ref name="r040">{{cite web | title=Eulogy | website=Marc Awodey | date=2015-11-05 | url=https://marcawodey.org/eulogy/ }}</ref>
